summary: Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss's US crypto exchange Gemini funneled customer deposits from its Earn program into the under-collateralized lender Genesis, which collapsed in 2022 with around a billion dollars of customer funds.
keywords: New York Department of Financial Services

evidence.note: 2004 Facebook dispute with Zuckerberg and the later settlement open the story
Gemini Earn launches in February 2021, start of the core events
segment on Singapore-based Three Arrows Capital and its Terra Luna losses
New York Attorney General fraud suit against Gemini, Genesis and DCG in October 2023
Gemini's own risk team flagged Genesis as highly leveraged while it kept sending customer funds
February 2024 NYDFS settlement promising return of funds to Earn customers

notes: Better Offline episode by Ed Zitron republished in the BtB feed, so format is crossover. Twins tagged as one group subject, so no lifespan is given. Barry Silbert gets real airtime but is kept in keywords as DCG's CEO. tech-internet rests on the brief Facebook origin segment and the crypto industry background.
